description: This file defines utility functions, constants, and data serialization/deserialization methods for the RPC (Remote Procedure Call) subsystem within PyTorch's distributed module. It includes functions for error handling, request/response deserialization, tensor handling, and profiling event management, serving as a support header for distributed RPC functionality.

methods.name: getRPCErrorType
methods.description: Determines the RPC error type from an associated JitFuture message.

methods.name: makeRPCError
methods.description: Constructs an error string based on provided error description and type.

methods.name: deserializeRequest
methods.description: Deserializes an incoming RPC request message into an RpcCommandBase object.

methods.name: deserializeResponse
methods.description: Deserializes an incoming RPC response message into an RpcCommandBase object, handling wrapped message types.

methods.name: deserializeRespToIValue
methods.description: Converts a response message into an IValue, for script RPC results.

methods.name: wireSerialize
methods.description: Serializes payload data and tensors into a wire format for RPC transmission.

methods.name: wireDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from wire format back into payload and tensors.

methods.name: cloneSparseTensors
methods.description: Creates clones of sparse tensors to optimize network transmission.

methods.name: writeWrappedPayload
methods.description: Combines original and additional payloads into a wrapped payload for RPC.

methods.name: readWrappedPayload
methods.description: Extracts and returns the original payload from a wrapped RPC payload.

methods.name: populateRemoteProfiledEvents
methods.description: Transfers autograd profiling events across RPC boundaries for profiling.
